$comment: PLACEHOLDER CONTENT. EVERY NUMBER IN THIS FILE IS A PLACEHOLDER PENDING GAME DESIGN.
Drop chances, quantities and despawn times are NOT design decisions; they exist only
so the Core v3 vertical slice can run. Design owns every value here.
Loot tables. SERVER-ONLY: never served at /content (loot is a server-side roll).
One table per entity type. Each entry is rolled independently: chancePermille in
1..1000, quantity uniform in [min, max] (max <= the item's stackMax).
despawnTicks is BASE SIMULATION TICKS a drop lies in the world (60 per second).
